cases.explain: Бог is the subject of the verb "возглашает", so nominative case.

cases.translation: Hear this, O house of Jacob.
cases.explain: Дом is in apposition to the subject, requiring nominative case.
Бога is the direct object of the transitive verb "ищите", so accusative case.

cases.sentence: Не говорил я в тайне из земли ___.
cases.translation: I have not spoken in secret in a dark place of the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition "из" (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Hear this word in my name.
cases.explain: Слово is the direct object of the transitive verb "услышьте", so accusative.
Правду is the direct object of the verb "возвещаю", so accusative.

cases.translation: The survivors of the nations will gather.
cases.explain: The preposition "из" (from, of) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: There is no other God besides me.
cases.explain: After "нет" (there is no), the genitive case is used.

reading.ru: Я не говорил в тайне, не из земли тьмы.
reading.question: Where did God not speak?
options: Not in secret, not from a dark place
reading.correct: Not in secret, not from a dark place
reading.explain: "Я не говорил в тайне, не из земли тьмы" — I have not spoken in secret, from a dark place.

reading.ru: Я не говорил потомкам Иакова, ищите меня впустую.
reading.question: What does God say to the descendants of Jacob?
options: I have not said Seek Me in vain
Seek Me and you will find Me
Seek Me with all your heart
reading.correct: I have not said Seek Me in vain
reading.explain: "Я не говорил потомкам Иакова, ищите меня впустую" — I did not say to the offspring of Jacob, "Seek me in vain."

reading.ru: Я, Господь, говорю истину, я возвещаю правду.
reading.question: What does the Lord speak?
reading.explain: "Я, Господь, говорю истину, я возвещаю правду" — I, the Lord, speak truth and declare what is right.

reading.ru: Соберитесь и придите, сойдитесь вместе, уцелевшие из народов.
reading.question: To whom does God call?
reading.explain: "уцелевшие из народов" — the remnant of the nations.

reading.ru: Я Господь, и другого нет, нет Бога, кроме меня.
reading.question: How does God identify Himself?
reading.explain: God declares His uniqueness: "Я Господь, и другого нет" — I am the Lord, and there is no other.

reading.ru: Обратитесь ко мне и будете спасены все края земли.
reading.question: What promise does God make?
options: All the ends of the earth shall be saved
Only the faithful will be saved
reading.correct: All the ends of the earth shall be saved
reading.explain: "Обратитесь ко мне и будете спасены все края земли" — Turn to me and be saved, all you ends of the earth.
